note: The private half of tests/data/auto_shape_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of Automatic picture shape (web/shapes.js's wayOf, automatic, picks and watch; web/shell.html's switch and pick functions; the Automatic row of web/shape_picker.js, web/game_menu.js and web/lobby.html) for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'). Run from the checkout: tools/mutate.py tests/data/auto_shape_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1; every mutant must be caught by the node check named in it (web_auto_shape_check.js, web_aspect_key_check.js, web_shape_picker_check.js, web_game_menu_check.js).
